name: Tom Hatch
residence: Sublette County (2026 general candidate listing, Big Piney)
occupation: Sublette County sheriff-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results). A 2024 official county employee public notice published in the Pinedale Roundup listed Thomas Hatch as a deputy in the Sheriff's Office (title only).
prior_offices: Deputy, Sublette County Sheriff's Office (title listed in the August 29, 2024, official county employee public notice)
background: Tom Hatch, listed as Thomas James Hatch on the official 2026 general candidate listing, is the Sublette County sheriff-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding K.C. Lehr, who is serving through the current term. A 2024 official county employee public notice published in the Pinedale Roundup listed Thomas Hatch as a deputy in the Sheriff's Office (title only). He won the August 2026 Republican primary and the November 2026 general election.
